 Tips on how to care for dry skin during the winter 
 By Jolie Jenkins Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 7:12 PM EST | Updated : 6 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SOUTHERN TIER, N.Y. (WBNG) — Cold weather can leave skin feeling dry, and online advice may not work for everyone.
 A basic skincare routine includes cleansing, moisturizing and applying sunscreen.
 A thicker moisturizer may be helpful during the winter months. Two ingredients to look for are hyaluronic acid, which helps skin retain water, and ceramides, which support the skin barrier.
 Sunscreen remains important in the winter, even when temperatures drop. According to an article by Mayo Clinic, the sun’s ultraviolet rays don’t disappear when temperatures drop or daylight hours get shorter.
 Board-certified dermatologist Dr. Howard-Verovic recommends paying attention to what your skin needs instead of opting for advice online.
 “Put the phone down. I know sometimes we’re always on the phone, but put it down and listen to your skin. Your skin will literally tell you what it needs,” Howard-Verovic said. “We mentioned before some words like dryness, irritation, tightness, scaling. These are some signs that your skin may need some extra support.”
